caption: The video captures a dark, intimate scene centered on an ornate metal candelabra holding four lit red candles. Each candle is thickly coated in layers of dripping, solidified wax that runs down its sides and pools around the holders. The flames burn steadily, their bright yellow-orange tongues flickering and swaying, casting a warm, shifting glow across the wax and the surrounding shadows. As the firelight pulses, the intensity and direction of the illumination subtly change, making the metal arms and the blurred background shimmer faintly. A very slight vibration or camera drift keeps the composition gently unsettled without altering the arrangement of the candles. The burning remains ongoing throughout, with the flames dancing against the deep black backdrop.
